name: (14) Animalism — 3 Advanced — Eye of the Szlachta

system.description:
Any Fiend who's been around for a while knows how to possess a lowly beast, but a few can ride any ghoul who shares their blood. By locking eyes with the ghoul (both parties must have eyes), the Fiend transfers his soul into the creature while his own body falls into a state resembling torpor. Some Tzimisce consider such intimate contact with their servants distasteful, but it is sometimes necessary to calm a rampaging vozhd in a disposable vessel, or to "fleshride" a ghoul who can speak and open doors.

System: Use the system for the Animalism power Subsume the Spirit, but the target must be one of the Tzimisce's own ghouls.

MET System: Impose your indomitable will onto one of your ghouls by spending a Willpower Trait, merging the two souls together. Each Mental Trait you spend increases the strength of the connection, lasting for one night: one Trait grants Simple Possession; two Traits let you also use Auspex; three Traits let you also use Animalism and Dominate; four Traits let you also use Vicissitude; five Traits let you also use Koldunic Sorcery, Necromancy, and Thaumaturgy (assuming the ghoul's blood grants access to those powers through its master).
system.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
